action_instruction: Checking whether the stored cart item appears in the checkout order summary
intent: whether the stored cart item appears in the checkout order summary

action_params.condition: every item stored in {{baseline_cart_items}} is present in the checkout order summary
action_params.query: whether the stored cart item appears in the checkout order summary
action_params.code_js: (() => { const t = (el(8)?.textContent || '').replace(/\s+/g,' '); return t.includes('Trail Runner Sneakers') && t.includes('$89.00') && t.includes('Qty: 1'); })()
locators: internal:text="👟 Trail Runner Sneakers $89.00 Qty: 1 $89.00 Order total: $"i

assertion_tree.description: every item stored in {{baseline_cart_items}} is present in the checkout order summary

sub_results.description: every item stored in {{baseline_cart_items}} is present in the checkout order summary

assertion_tree.verification: The checkout order summary shows every item stored in {{baseline_cart_items}} as present
